3.title: Exp 03: Basic Arithmetic Operations on 8-Bit Data
3.notes: Aim: Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division on 8-bit data. | Category: ALU Arithmetic Operations
3.code:
.MODEL SMALL
.DATA
    NUM1 DB 14H
    NUM2 DB 06H
    SUM  DB ?
    DIFF DB ?
    PROD DW ?
    QUOT DB ?
    REM  DB ?
.CODE
MAIN PROC
    MOV AX, @DATA
    MOV DS, AX
    MOV AL, NUM1
    ADD AL, NUM2
    MOV SUM, AL
    MOV AL, NUM1
    SUB AL, NUM2
    MOV DIFF, AL
    MOV AL, NUM1
    MOV BL, NUM2
    MUL BL
    MOV PROD, AX
    MOV AX, 0000H
    MOV AL, NUM1
    DIV BL
    MOV QUOT, AL
    MOV REM, AH
    MOV AH, 4CH
    INT 21H
MAIN ENDP
END MAIN

4.title: Exp 04: Basic Logical Operations (AND, OR, XOR, NOT) on 8-Bit Data
4.notes: Aim: Perform AND, OR, XOR, and NOT on 8-bit data. | Category: ALU Logical Operations
4.code:
.MODEL SMALL
.DATA
    OP1     DB 92H
    OP2     DB 6AH
    RES_AND DB ?
    RES_OR  DB ?
    RES_XOR DB ?
    RES_NOT DB ?
.CODE
MAIN PROC
    MOV AX, @DATA
    MOV DS, AX
    MOV AL, OP1
    AND AL, OP2
    MOV RES_AND, AL
    MOV AL, OP1
    OR  AL, OP2
    MOV RES_OR, AL
    MOV AL, OP1
    XOR AL, OP2
    MOV RES_XOR, AL
    MOV AL, OP1
    NOT AL
    MOV RES_NOT, AL
    MOV AH, 4CH
    INT 21H
MAIN ENDP
END MAIN

8.title: Exp 08: Sorting an Array of 8-Bit Numbers in Ascending Order
8.notes: Aim: Sort an array of 8-bit numbers in ascending order using Bubble Sort. | Category: Data Manipulation / Sorting
8.code:
.MODEL SMALL
.DATA
    ARRAY DB 45H, 12H, 78H, 34H
    COUNT EQU 4
.CODE
MAIN PROC
    MOV AX, @DATA
    MOV DS, AX
    MOV CX, COUNT - 1
OUTER:
    MOV DX, CX
    LEA SI, ARRAY
INNER:
    MOV AL, [SI]
    CMP AL, [SI + 1]
    JBE NO_SWAP
    XCHG AL, [SI + 1]
    MOV [SI], AL
NO_SWAP:
    INC SI
    DEC DX
    JNZ INNER
    LOOP OUTER
    MOV AH, 4CH
    INT 21H
MAIN ENDP
END MAIN

9.title: Exp 09: Block Transfer using Index Registers (SI and DI)
9.notes: Aim: Transfer a block of data using the SI and DI index registers. | Category: Memory Block Transfer
9.code:
.MODEL SMALL
.DATA
    SRC_BLK  DB 10H, 20H, 30H, 40H, 50H
    DEST_BLK DB 5 DUP(0)
    COUNT    EQU 5
.CODE
MAIN PROC
    MOV AX, @DATA
    MOV DS, AX
    MOV ES, AX
    LEA SI, SRC_BLK
    LEA DI, DEST_BLK
    MOV CX, COUNT
    CLD
    REP MOVSB
    MOV AH, 4CH
    INT 21H
MAIN ENDP
END MAIN
